title: teucrium leucosceptrum
intro: Teucrium leucosceptrum, commonly known as Mountain Teucrium or White-tipped Teucrium, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Teucrium leucosceptrum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
